description: Moodle Web Services expose each Moodle site's enabled LMS functions through site-specific endpoints and protocols such as REST. Each site controls its services, functions, and user tokens. Moodle may be self-hosted, hosted directly by Moodle through MoodleCloud, or hosted by a Moodle Certified Partner or Service Provider; there is no single global API endpoint.
resolution_notes: cors: Set to yes. Moodle 5.2 says Moodle sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for Web Service requests, though infrastructure may remove it: https://docs.moodle.org/502/en/Moodle_app_FAQ. description: Corrected. Moodle lists three deployment paths—MoodleCloud hosted by Moodle, Certified Partners/Service Providers, and self-hosting: https://support.moodle.com/support/solutions/articles/80000825155-moodlecloud-and-moodle-hosting-options
